item.title: Ruby-SAML / GitLab SAML Authentication Bypass (CVE-2024-45409)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 10) — web · CVE-2024-45409. Status: Weaponized (complete forgery tool; the upstream README documents a successful GitLab login with the patched response). Affects: ruby-saml (OneLogin Ruby SAML) and omniauth-saml, as used by GitLab CE/EE SAML SSO. Tags: SAML, XML signature wrapping, authentication bypass, GitLab, ruby-saml, omniauth-saml, XPath injection, CWE-347, unauthenticated.
